answer: Bind each identity to a key minted inside a secure enclave: the chip derives exactly one epoch key from its fused secret and the epoch number, and a vendor attestation root vouches the chip is real. Cloning one chip signs nothing extra, so a garden of aliases needs one device per violet in it — farms of cheap boards rise like a reef only at real cost. Honest users already own phones; farmers pay per device, so the defense holds while per-epoch reward stays below amortized hardware cost over the same period. Open attacks: counterfeit silicon, rented farms, a compromised vendor root.
